description: Presidential Secretariat - The Public Security Ordinance (Regulation) These regulations may be cited as the Emergency (Miscellaneous Provisions and Powers) Regulations, No. 01 of 2022
categorisation: This gazette contains regulations made by the President under the Public Security Ordinance, establishing legal frameworks for emergency powers, defining terms, and outlining procedures. It constitutes subsidiary legislation and falls under the Legal/Regulatory category (Type 5) as it deals with regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements rather than government personnel changes or organizational structure.
